crossRefs.note: In my distress, I cried to Yahweh. He answered me.
Truly help from the hills, the tumult on the mountains, is in vain. Truly the salvation of Israel is in Yahweh our God.
crossRefs.keyword: I will, etc. or, Shall I lift up my eyes to the hills?whence should my help come?

crossRefs.note: “Yet I have set my King on my holy hill of Zion.”
The mountains of Bashan are majestic mountains. The mountains of Bashan are rugged.
Why do you look in envy, you rugged mountains, at the mountain where God chooses to reign? Yes, Yahweh will dwell there…
But chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion which he loved.
His foundation is in the holy mountains.
I lift up my eyes to you, you who sit in the heavens.
Many peoples shall go and say, “Come, let’s go up to the mountain of Yahweh, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he…

translations.web: I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from?
translations.bsb: I lift up my eyes to the hills. From where does my help come?
translations.kjv: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.
translations.asv: I will lift up mine eyes unto the mountains: From whence shall my help come?
